task_completion.description: Locate the 'Investigation_Board_Alpha' layout under the user's private layouts in the resource tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'Investigation_Board_Alpha' listed under the 'Layouts' or 'User' section in the left-hand resource tree of the Nx Witness client.

task_completion.description: Access the settings or properties menu for the 'Investigation_Board_Alpha' layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A context menu (right-click) or a 'Layout Settings' dialog box appearing over the main interface.

task_completion.description: Select the option to 'Make Shared' or 'Save as Shared Layout'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor clicking on a 'Make Shared' button or a checkbox labeled 'Shared' being toggled in the layout settings dialog.

task_completion.description: Confirm the layout has moved from the private user section to the 'Shared Layouts' section of the resource tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Investigation_Board_Alpha' layout appearing under the 'Shared Layouts' node in the resource tree, no longer restricted to the specific user's folder.

task_completion.description: Ensure the layout still contains its camera views after promotion.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout is opened in the main viewing grid, showing at least two distinct camera tiles/video feeds.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI rather than executing background scripts or terminal commands to move the layout.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, menu clicks, and dialog interactions within the Nx Witness desktop client.

integrity.description: The agent promoted the existing layout rather than creating a new empty shared layout and renaming it.
integrity.visual_evidence: The process shows the 'Make Shared' workflow on the original layout rather than a 'New Layout' creation sequence.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with a live instance of Nx Witness, not static images or mockups.
integrity.visual_evidence: Dynamic UI elements like timestamps, hover states, or loading spinners are visible during the transition.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target layout is named 'Investigation_Board_Alpha'. To be considered 'Shared' in Nx Witness, the layout must be moved to the 'Shared Layouts' folder in the resource tree. The layout must contain at least 2 camera items to be considered intact. Promotion is typically achieved via right-click > 'Make Shared' or through the 'Layout Settings' dialog.
